findings: The canonical V366 Startseite counted ready plants with start + duration and ignored the live-weather growth multiplier.
The canonical V492 Growroom actually uses ((now-start) * weatherGrowMul) / duration, so rain/cloud/thunder/frost could make the Startseite ready count disagree with the Growroom.

The lower Startseite Growroom strip reused the ready-count variable but labelled it as plants that are growing, so e.g. four growing plants and zero ready plants could display as '0 Pflanzen wachsen'.
changes: Beta now computes Startseite Growroom readiness with the same V492 live-weather formula.
The main Growroom card is corrected to the real number of harvest-ready plants.
The lower Growroom strip now reports total active plants and, when applicable, how many are ready.
A single one-shot timer is scheduled for the next plant readiness transition so the Startseite can update without a polling loop or full home rebuild.
A narrow body data-gl-weather observer only reschedules this status when the weather kind/multiplier changes.
No grow state is mutated; this is display-only.
diagnostics: window.v8009HomeHeaderDiagnostics() reports growStatusPatches, growReadyTimerFires and growWeatherReschedules; #world exposes v8009GrowReady/v8009GrowActive/v8009GrowWeatherMul data fields.
